close_reason: Acceptance law transferred to fz-tfn.53 unified publication boundary
description:
## Status

Absorbed into `fz-tfn.53`, the typed atomic source-publication cutover.

## Preserved law

`CallSiteMap` and `CallSiteTargetsMap` have exactly the lifetime of their authoritative `CallSiteSummary`/`CallSiteTargets` fact claims. When the last publisher retracts, the typed value disappears; a later `Unresolved` publication begins a fresh epoch and cannot inherit stale `Resolved` content. Multi-publisher withdrawal prunes only after the final claim leaves.

`fz-tfn.53` must prove resolved → absent → unresolved at the unified publication boundary and remove store-without-ledger helpers. It must not implement the old proposed after-the-fact scan of `FactChange`, add per-reader `has_fact` gates, or retain a second cleanup authority.

No standalone implementation remains; the law and its production-boundary test are acceptance criteria of `fz-tfn.53`.
title: Absorbed: callsite values follow typed publication lifetime
